The unsuccessful observer setup pressed no movement keys and is not counted as a native pass. All observation uses tab.evaluate; raw Puppeteer only supplies real keys/CDP/screenshots. A RAF callback sampler subsequently returned zero observations and the browser helper hung; that attempt is also excluded. The final smoke instead uses the already successful runner pattern: synchronous real snapshots plus trusted keys, with no installed RAF callback.

KORO’S SKILLS

Your equipped companion supports you automatically and reserves one command token for your orders. Strong support has its own cooldown; buffs expire and cannot stack by swapping companions. Hold R to choose a command and target, then release. C opens this panel. “Use now” resumes the game and performs the real action.

Mending Seed Wood

Toss a Wood seed at a nearby enemy. On contact, restore 8% of your maximum Vitality, never above full health. No vitality damage. 14-second support cooldown.

Mends you below 85% Vitality while an enemy is engaged.

1 command token · Koro has not joined your journey yet. Cleanse him in Whispering Canopy.

Preview animation + VFX
Use now · return to game
Move Object Earth

Walk to a marked movable object, plant both hands and push it along its authored route. Equip Koro; does not share Mending Seed’s cooldown.

Objects move only on your order; story interactions are never triggered automatically.

1 command token · Koro has not joined your journey yet. Cleanse him in Whispering Canopy.

Preview animation + VFX
Use now · return to game
Distract Wood

An arm-wave draws a non-boss enemy’s attention for 3 seconds. Free; the same target cannot be locked into a permanent distraction.

Use on command when you want Koro to draw attention.

Investigate a discovered trace or survey nearby ground to reveal traps. Free; available to your one equipped companion.

Searching and story interactions wait for your order.
